description:
Use this when you need an auditable state/territory working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the division is unknown or the task requires a local/employer/exchange calendar.
What it computes: Counts working and non-working dates for a selected Australian state or territory in 2026-2027.
Example user requests: Count NSW working days from 2026-04-20 to 2026-05-04.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); division (enum); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-04-20","end_date":"2026-05-04","division":"nsw","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, division, division_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_observed, limited_or_part_day_events, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, regional_policy, dataset_version.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += selected status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/australia-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/australia-working-days-between.md

division.description: Required Australian state/territory code: act, nsw, nt, qld, sa, tas, vic or wa.

name: count_australia_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: State/territory-wide full-day public holidays plus weekly baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or public holiday.

holiday_names.description: Full-day public holidays applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when an additional/substitute date is explicitly listed.

is_working_day.description: True when the date is not a weekend or included full-day state/territory public holiday.

limited_or_part_day_events.description: Regional, partial-day, public-service-only or otherwise limited events that do not close the full division by default.

source_quality.description: Official government sources with state/territory scope.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Australia State/Territory Working Days
